definitions.explanation: The muscular organ in the mouth used for tasting, speaking, and eating.

examples.japanese: {熱|あつ}い{物|もの}で{舌|した}を{火傷|やけど}した。
examples.english: I burned my tongue on something hot.

notes:
{舌|した} refers to the tongue, the organ used for tasting and speaking.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {舌|した}を{出|だ}す: to stick out one's tongue
- {舌|した}を{巻|ま}く: to be amazed/impressed
- {舌|した}が{回|まわ}る: to speak fluently
- {舌|した}を{噛|か}む: to bite one's tongue (also: to trip over words)

COMPOUNDS:
- {舌先|したさき}: tip of the tongue
- {毒舌|どくぜつ}: sharp tongue, caustic remarks
- {二枚舌|にまいじた}: double-tongued, deceitful
- {舌打|したう}ち: clicking one's tongue (in disapproval)

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {口|くち}: mouth
- {唇|くちびる}: lips
- {歯|は}: teeth
